newsitem.title: UK: CSFB expands European syndicated finance team.
newsitem.headline: CSFB expands European syndicated finance team.

text.p: Credit Suisse First Boston (CSFB) said on Thursday it had appointed three new senior members to its Syndicated Finance team as part of its objective to expand its acquisition and high yield finance business globally.
It said Richard Atterbury, formerly a senior managing director with Bank of America in Chicago, would join the firm as a managing director to expand the Origination and Acquisition Finance team.
Grant Johnson was joining CSFB as a managing director and head of Loan Syndications for Europe from NatWest Markets where he was a managing director, CSFB said in a statement.

It said the third new member was David Slade who was also joining the firm from NatWest Markets where he was director of High Yield Finance and head of European Origination. He has been appointed a director in CSFB's Loan Syndications team reporting to Grant Johnson.
CSFB said Tony Rhodes, former head of Loan Syndications for Europe, and Simon Jackson, formerly a director in Loan Syndications, had left the firm.
